reply: nal was a t^1.5/x term with coefficient about 0.143, plus roughly 3.9·√t. The residual still depends on v in a curved way, and the velocity dependence is the main thing left unresolved. The ~7e-5 candidates from earlier attempts were already close, so my version improves only by about a factor of 5.

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    return p[0] + p[1]*t**1.5/x + p[2]*np.sqrt(t) + p[3]*np.log(v) + p[4]*v + p[5]*np.sqrt(v) + p[6]*t + p[7]*x + p[8]/x + p[9]*v*v
